title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-04-04
content:
Daily scratchpad - 2026-04-04
Owner: Aisha Patel (PM, Hosted API)
Context: Finalizing PRD edits and launch checklist for batching & caching rollout to Hosted API. Quick working notes, meeting action items, and outstanding decisions. Informal - notes to self.

Today
- Block: 9:00-11:00 AM - PRD pass + open comments review (goal: ship version v1.3 to docs by EOD).
- 11:15 AM - Sync with Marco (infra) - verify infra scaling numbers for dedicated fallback.
- 1:00 PM - Stakeholder demo prep (GTM + CS).
- 3:00 PM - Weekly product-all-hands: 10min highlight on rollout plan.

Top priorities
1) Finalize PRD: batching/caching defaults + quantization guidance for hosted models. Need to incorporate Li's perf numbers and Samir's security wording.
2) Launch checklist: ensure monitoring dashboards have token-level cost widget + regression alert set.
3) Stakeholder comms: send one-pager for GTM and CS with rollback plan and SLOs.

PRD edits to complete (trackers)
- Perf table: replace draft numbers with Li's 04/02 run (p95 latency, throughput/cost). (Action: Li to confirm by noon)
- Safety/PII paragraph: add Samir's suggestion about sanitized logs + KMS references. (Action: Samir to drop snippet)
- API contract: add sample request/response for streaming + function-calling fallback. (Action: Aisha to add example)
- Rollout strategy: add canary window + automatic fallback to cheaper model variant on error-rate spike. (Action: Marco to confirm autoscaler behavior)

Launch checklist (working) - status markers: TODO / IN_PROGRESS / DONE
- [IN_PROGRESS] Docs: PRD v1.3 completed (this doc). Draft published to Confluence.
- [TODO] Release notes: write short notes for developer changelog + migration notes for customers. (owner: Aisha)
- [IN_PROGRESS] Dashboards: token-cost + p95 latency + model-fallback-rate. (owner: observability - Samir)
- [TODO] Alerts: regression alert tied to prompt set (evals). (owner: product-quality)
- [TODO] Canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h -> 25% for 24h -> 100% (owner: infra - Marco)
- [TODO] CS playbook: steps to communicate and assist customers during canary. (owner: CS)
- [DONE] Security review: initial review complete, awaiting KMS wording.
- [TODO] Rollback plan: automated fallback route configured + manual playbook. (owner: infra + Aisha)

Stakeholder follow-ups
- Marco: confirm autoscaler behavior on mixed-batch workloads (ask: min GPUs, burst capacity policy). (due: 2026-04-05)
- Li: confirm perf runs (p50/p95/p99) for seq_len=1024 and seq_len=256 and attach CSV. (due: 2026-04-04 noon)
- Samir: KMS wording + sanitized logs snippet for PRD. (due: 2026-04-04 EOD)
- GTM (Marta): finalize demo script and one-pager for Sales. (due: 2026-04-06)

Meeting notes (11:15 sync with Marco)
- Infra concern: autoscaler currently uses token-rate heuristic; we should add latency-based signal for model-fallback trigger. Action: Marco to prototype threshold logic and share config by Tue.
- Capacity: suggested reserved burst pool of 10% for canary to prevent noisy neighbor eviction.
- Fallbacks: need clear mapping table of compatible model variants (quantized vs full precision). I'll add to PRD.

Open questions / decisions needed
- Q: Do we expose batching/caching knobs to end-users or keep server-side managed only? Pros/cons listed in PRD but need a recommendation. Draft recommendation: server-managed default + advanced config behind feature flag for enterprise customers. (Decision needed by 2026-04-07)
- Q: Rollout SLO for p95 latency during canary - what is acceptable deviation? Proposed: +15% over baseline for up to 24h. Need sign-off from SRE.
- Q: How to instrument token-level cost attribution for server-side caching savings? (ask observability for tagging approach)

Tomorrow
- Morning: finish PRD edits and publish to Confluence.
- Afternoon: prep short one-pager for GTM + send stakeholder email with timeline + risks.

Notes to self
- Keep the PRD conversational in opening section - explain the rationale (we reduce unit token cost without changing API surface).
- Add quick troubleshooting checklist for CS: common causes of increased latency during canary and quick mitigation steps.

Quick links
- PRD (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRD/hosted-api-batching-optimization
- Perf CSV (Li): https://files.redwood.ai/perf/batching-run-2026-04-02.csv
- Jira epic: JIRA-INF-2345
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1187

Action items (short)
- Aisha: add API example + release notes draft (today).
- Marco: autoscaler latency-signal prototype (by Tue).
- Li: perf numbers CSV (noon today).
- Samir: KMS/logging snippet (EOD).

End of scratchpad.
